step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard depicts a multi-region architecture for Xero's bank feed processing. At the top, external banks (ThirdParty) send transaction files. Route 53 routes incoming traffic across two regions (Region 1 and Region 2). In Region 1, Route 53 points to an ELB, which forwards traffic to an EC2 processing instance; S3 is present alongside. In Region 2, Route 53 similarly points to an ELB, which forwards traffic to an EC2 processing instance, accompanied by an S3 bucket. At the bottom, SNS, SQS, and an EC2 BATCH worker instance are drawn as standalone components without explicit directional connection arrows.
